body:
Replace the Opus minimum for subagents and workflows with task-shape tiers. The old minimum rested on Opus 4.8 at low effort beating Sonnet 4.6 at high effort. Nobody re-measured that on the 5.5 generation.

| Tier | Model | Fits |
|------|-------|------|
| Judgement | `opus` (default) | Review, debugging, design, multi-file edits, untrusted input, output nothing downstream checks |
| Hardest | `fable` | Long-horizon or adversarial reasoning |
| Bounded | `sonnet` + explicit effort | The done check fits in one sentence, and a wrong answer is cheap to catch |
| Mechanical | `haiku` | A lean reader or a workflow stage whose output a stronger stage or a script checks |

Haiku stays narrower than Sonnet because of `docs/audits/haiku-5.5-reevaluation-2026-10-10.md`: Haiku 5.5 read files reliably, but only 46% of its judgement calls held up under Opus verification. GitHub workflows still need a per-workflow replay before they can use haiku. Existing agents and workflows stay on opus until a measurement backs moving them. #3116 tracks the calibration run.

Guards:
- `check-agent-model.sh` accepts `sonnet` with an explicit `effort:`. It now reads model and effort from the whole frontmatter: previously an invalid effort past line 20 passed. It also strips CR before the `---` test, so CRLF agent files are no longer read as having no frontmatter.
- `check-workflow-js-model.sh` accepts `sonnet` and `fable` stages.
- `check-workflow-model.sh` accepts `fable` and `sonnet`.
- The `non_opus_model` issue type becomes `disallowed_model`.

Each relaxation has fixture tests. I mutation-checked them: the new cases fail when the old acceptance logic is restored.

Rules, docs and skill text that still claimed an Opus minimum are updated in the same change: `agent-development.md`, `skill-development.md`, `workflow-model-effort.md`, `workflow-vs-skill.md`, `regression-testing.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `agents-plugin` README and `agents-analyze`, `custom-agent-definitions`, `adversarial-review`, `attribute-router`, and the PR-checks step name.

Not in this PR: the user-global `~/.claude/rules/agent-and-tool-selection.md` (chezmoi) still states the Opus minimum and needs the same revision.

Refs #3116
